All were unresolved because the trajectory exports contain unknown global sources. The requested false-safe and false-refusal rates are unidentified, not zero. `wfg_synthetic_truth.score_decision` enforces the three outcome states, rejects truth/planning identity leakage and refuses a contact-only clairvoyant reference masquerading as a full-policy optimum. Unknown check support produces null scores. A refusal with a checked full-policy clairvoyant route is flagged false-refusal; a checked journey violating known truth contact is false-safe.
